wellSetup.description: Inject bottom rows with a vertical I-shaped gap into LCD RAM; set decimal score digits only for boundary cases. ROM, CPU clock and gameplay code stay unchanged.

otherDevices.procedure: Boot 3s, Mute, Down to slot, Start, wait 2s, hold Rotate 600ms, release 200ms. E88 uses the same LCD RAM mapping as E23.
